---
title: "Patch supplementary figure — APOE genotype boxplots"
---

## Overview

Apply publication theming to the combined APOE genotype boxplot (threshold 7) and save as a high-resolution PNG for the supplementary figure.

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| echo: false

pacman::p_load(ggtext, install = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: setup-theme

source(here("custom_func/theme_main_fig.R"))
set_pub_geom_defaults()
```

## Load and patch figure

```{r}
#| label: patch-suppl-apoe-boxplot

fig_suppl_apoe <- read_rds(
  here("APOE/output/apoe_boxplot_thr7_combined.rds")
)

fig_suppl_apoe <- fig_suppl_apoe +
  theme_main_fig() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    plot.subtitle = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = ggtext::element_markdown(angle = 30, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 2, b = 2, l = 2, r = 2)
  )
fig_suppl_apoe <- rescale_layer_params(fig_suppl_apoe, linewidth_scale = 0.6)

fs::dir_create(here("APOE/patch_figures/output"))
ggsave(here("APOE/patch_figures/output/fig_suppl_apoe_boxplot.png"),
       fig_suppl_apoe,
       width = 6.5, height = 1.6, dpi = 600, bg = "white",
       device = grDevices::png)
```

## Verify output

```{r}
#| label: verify-output

output_files <- fs::dir_ls(
  here("APOE/patch_figures/output"),
  glob = "*suppl_apoe*"
)
fs::file_info(output_files) |>
  select(path, size, modification_time) |>
  mutate(path = basename(path))
```
